kizunaNote: PostgREST RPC body for kizunasync.push: top-level keys are SQL argument names. Client identity rides the optional client_id key (D-client-identity), with the Supabase Auth JWT session_id claim as the fallback when it is absent.

batch.kizunaNote: One server transaction per batch; idempotent via mutation UUIDs (P:verdict-completeness-transforms-and-conflict-rejection). Batch and mutation key spellings are this schema.

atomic.kizunaNote: Headline semantics are normative (P:verdict-completeness-transforms-and-conflict-rejection): flagged means all-or-nothing and one rejection reverts the batch; unflagged returns per-mutation verdicts. D-atomic-batch-abort decided the abort response details, and executable push/005 pins the selected atomic outcome.

mutations.kizunaNote: Column-masked apply: arrival-mode tables resolve by server arrival; hlc-mode tables resolve masked columns by origin HLC (P:verdict-completeness-transforms-and-conflict-rejection, conflict/003).

client_id.kizunaNote: Optional client identity, decided by D-client-identity: when present the server registers the client under it, when absent it falls back to the Supabase Auth JWT session_id claim. A uuid string; the UUID placeholder grammar uses kind code c1.

last_mutation_id.kizunaNote: Exactly-once-effect dedup watermark (P:session-guarantees-and-exactly-once-effect; _clients.last_mutation_id, SQL:clients-last-mutation-id). Reconciliation of the single watermark vs per-mutation verdict replay is D-dedup-storage-model: transcripts assert only observables valid under either reading (replay returns the recorded verdicts; effects never double-applied).

schema_version.kizunaNote: Normative: 'Every RPC carries schema_version' (P:schema-version-signalling). D-schema-version-handshake decided the public push parameter, and 0001_kizuna_init.sql enforces it. Integer >= 1.
